annotations.title: ERC-20 spender allowance and balance safety check

description: Inspect an EVM wallet's ERC-20 token balance and spender allowance on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, or Optimism without raw RPC calls. Pass 0x `owner` wallet address, 0x `token` contract address, 0x `spender` address (all required), and optional `chain` (`base`, `ethereum`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`; default `base`). Returns `symbol`, `decimals`, `owner_balance`, `allowance`, `is_unlimited_approval`, and safety verdict. Do not use for Solana wallets (use get_solana_wallet_holdings) or token contract rug audits (use check_evm_token_risk). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.002 USDC).

session_token.description: Optional prepaid x402s_... session token from open_agent_session or https://apix402data.com/pay used after the 1 free try rolls over to HTTP 402.

timeout_ms.description: Optional deadline in ms. If the local LLM would exceed it, the response comes back fast with "degraded": true and non-LLM/cached data
